title: The Truth No One Told You about Adult Friendship
coreMove: Adult friendships drift because proximity, timing, and shared energy fade, not because people stopped caring. Name the missing condition and you can stop reading distance as rejection.

exampleSpecs.audience: Katya and readers facing the Great Scattering
exampleSpecs.stakes: Early friendship feels easy because institutions quietly provide the structure.
